assessment.rationale: Held: the Main KPI of 50 conflict-prone countries monitored by an early-warning system that predicts conflicts a year ahead is already met by an open, discoverable system. VIEWS (Uppsala University and PRIO) describes itself as an open-source project using AI to predict armed conflict 1 to 36 months ahead across the globe, releasing monthly country and sub-national forecasts, with the latest release covering September 2026 to August 2029 (https://viewsforecasting.org/); its forecasting code, pipeline and 2023 prediction-competition benchmarks are public on GitHub (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=org%3Aprio-data%20views&sort=stars&per_page=8), and the method is peer reviewed (https://doi.org/10.1177/0022343319823860). conflictforecast.org separately publishes the risk of an internal armed conflict outbreak within the next twelve months for countries not in conflict (https://conflictforecast.org/). A 2023 comparison of early-warning systems finds considerable overlap in which countries they flag as highest risk (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijforecast.2023.01.001). So both the deliverable (a year-ahead early-warning system) and the coverage target are achieved openly. Honest limit: forecasting the onset of conflict in previously peaceful places remains hard and is where accuracy is weakest; a reframed project with its own KPI on onset accuracy or on turning warnings into prevention would need its own prior-art basis, but this one is not opened as new work.

additionalSearches.query: ViEWS violence early warning system forecasts armed conflict
additionalSearches.finding: ViEWS: A political violence early-warning system (JPR 2019, 173 citations), ViEWS2020 revision and evaluation (2021), and a 2023 review and comparison of conflict early-warning systems. Established, peer-reviewed open system.

additionalSearches.query: conflict forecasting prediction challenge 2023 2024 fatalities months ahead (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 434 works: a global dataset on conflict forecasts and news topics (2024), transformer and attention models for fatality forecasting tied to the VIEWS challenge. Active open benchmark community.

37 repositories from PRIO: viewsforecasting monthly forecast scripts, views_pipeline with MLops and QA, prediction_competition_2023 benchmarks and evaluation, the views API and outreach docs updated October 2026. Open code confirmed.

additionalSearches.query: conflict onset prediction accuracy new conflicts hard cases (2024 onward)
additionalSearches.finding: 11,739 loosely matched works; relevant items compare NLP methods for crisis early warning (2026) and spatio-temporal fatality prediction. Onset accuracy remains an open research question, recorded as the honest limit.

An open-source project leveraging AI to predict armed conflict 1-36 months ahead across the globe; monthly forecasts at country and sub-national levels; latest release September 2026 to August 2029; source code page linked.
Shows the risk of an outbreak of internal armed conflict within the next twelve months for countries not in conflict, and forecast intensity for those in conflict.
